notes: §1985:VIII.4.4.4 GR19: "If the execution of the OPEN statement is unsuccessful, the physical file is not affected" and then, in order, a. the I-O status is set and b. any applicable USE AFTER EXCEPTION procedure runs. EmitOpen emits, per file-name, FileConnector.Open (which returns 35/37/39/41 before touching the medium), then EmitStoreFileStatus (a), then EmitUseHook (b) inside EmitOpenScope, so a mode-scoped USE sees the being-opened mode (§1985:VIII.4.8.4 GR5) and a file-name USE takes precedence (GR4); the 85 compile reaches the same emitter. Probed at 85 on relative SEQUENTIAL/DYNAMIC/RANDOM files: absent file OPEN EXTEND/I-O/INPUT 35 with the file-name USE seeing 35 and no file created; I-O on an absent dynamic file runs the I-O USE, INPUT with no INPUT USE runs none; OPEN INPUT RA RB fails each separately; OPTIONAL EXTEND absent 05 and creates the file (GR15); OPEN OUTPUT and I-O while open 41 with the OUTPUT/I-O USE run and records ONE/TWO intact; I-O relative over a sequential file 39, the sequential data intact; READ after a failed OPEN 47, CLOSE 42; no FILE STATUS and no USE is a fatal stop (implementor's critical-error action, GR6). Edition arms at 85: >>TURN COBOL0900, USE AFTER EXCEPTION CONDITION COBOL0877/0878, USE without AFTER COBOL0900, EXTEND on random access COBOL2372. Witness: five failed OPENs, an OPEN-while-open and a CLOSE WITH LOCK reopen, each USE seeing the status already set.

next.reason: 1985 (1993 amendment): an unsuccessful OPEN leaves 'the physical file' unaffected, then 'a. A value is placed in the I-O status', then 'b. Any applicable USE AFTER EXCEPTION procedure is executed.' §2023:14.9.27.4 GR25 keeps 'the file is not affected', a) the I-O status, and d) 'Any applicable USE FOR EXCEPTION or USE AFTER EXCEPTION procedure is executed', but adds cases: b) 'If it is enabled, the level-3 EC-I-O exception condition ... is set to exist', and c) an OPEN in an exception-checking PERFORM with an applicable WHEN phrase continues at that WHEN phrase and 'No applicable USE declarative is executed'. §2023:14.9.49.4 GR6 runs USE procedures only when the statement is outside an exception-checking PERFORM or no WHEN matched. Those programs (>>TURN, exception-checking PERFORM, USE FOR EXCEPTION) are accepted by 2023 and refused by 1985, and for them the result differs: a case added, so CHANGED. §2023:14.9.27.4 GR1 restates the I-O status update.
